node.statement: In the context of 1.1, W is nonempty and the row set is finite, so C=conv{p_w : w in W} is a nonempty compact convex subset of finite-dimensional l1 space. By 1.1.1, dist_1(p_v,C)=H. Therefore, after the support fact 1.1.2 is validated, universal instantiation of 1.1.2 with x0=p_v and this C yields an affine phi with phi(p_v)=H, phi(x)<=dist_1(x,C) for all x, and linear part of l_infty norm at most 1.
